title: Energy Analyst Services Entitlement Card — Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Energy Analyst Services Entitlement Card

Quick reference to the analyst entitlements each tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions carries.

| Tier | Analyst hours included per subscription year | Rate for analyst hours beyond the included pool (USD per hour) | Requested analysis delivered within (business days) | Site utility rate structure kept current by the analyst | Demand response enrollment and settlement support included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | 2.0 | 195 | 15 | no | no |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | 6.0 | 188 | 12 | yes | no |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | 16.0 | 180 | 10 | yes | yes |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | 32.0 | 172 | 7 | yes | yes |
| Measurement & Verification Program | 60.0 | 165 | 5 | yes | yes |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | 160.0 | 158 | 3 | yes | yes |


## Card notes

- The included hours are decimal hours for one subscription year: 2 hours on the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription rising to 160 hours on the Managed Energy Performance Program.
- The hourly rate is the tier's rate for analyst hours beyond the included pool, in USD per hour.
- Turnaround is counted in business days.
- Rate structure maintenance is included from the Metering & Dashboard Subscription upward; demand response support from the Energy Analytics Subscription upward.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription includes 32.0 analyst hours a year, bills further hours at USD 172 an hour, delivers a requested analysis within 7 business days, and includes both rate structure maintenance and demand response support.
